Noah (AE): Velaris CISO paused the POC. Blocking: BYO-KMS attestation + ASN/IP peering. They want a firm demo start next Thu. Need exec alignment. @Carmen @Ravi :warning:
Carmen (Solutions): Fast path = Dedicated + managed-KMS + IP allowlist (demo in ~3bd). Full BYO-KMS + attestation for Private ~10bd. We should offer phased swap plan and a clear swap date.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Connector + KMS handoff work: containerized connector + mutual TLS + HSM handshake tests. ETA ~7-9 business days. If they accept managed-KMS for demo with guaranteed swap date, we can meet next Thu.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft BYO-KMS clause + attestation addendum. Need the customer's questionnaire to map evidence. ETA draft: EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Note: egress peering requires ASN and authorized IPs from customer. Ops owner: Casey.
sec-bot: Reminder: include audit-log retention and encryption-in-transit details for questionnaire responses.
Noah (AE): Customer also wants a demo SLA: p95 < 500ms for short-chat and a fallback rule to quantized model if SLA breached twice in a row. Carmen please include SLA + cost delta in the brief.
Carmen (Solutions): Will prepare a 1-pager with three options (fast demo, full private, hybrid swap) + simple cost table + fallback SLAs. Targeting 3pm PT sync.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): I'll post a short runbook snippet and connector risk notes by 2pm PT. Example fallback config to include:
```
fallback:
  trigger: p95_ms > 500 for 2 windows
  action: switch_model rwd-small-int8
```
Marta (Legal): ACK. I'll include mapping skeleton for the questionnaire and attach SOC2 & pen-test links when available.
Noah (AE): Action items recap: 1) Carmen one-pager (cost + SLA) before sync, 2) Ravi connector ETA + runbook by 2pm, 3) Marta BYO-KMS draft EOD tomorrow, 4) Ops to collect ASN/IPs from Velaris. I'll paste meeting notes after sync. Keep updates in-thread only. :lock:
